lessons.title: Limit shared memory usage
lessons.summary: Choose block dimensions small enough to fit the GPU's shared‑memory budget.
lessons.lesson: When launching a Triton kernel, set BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N, and BLOCK_K to values (e.g., ≤64) that keep required shared memory below the device limit; if needed, lower num_stages.

lessons.title: Match stride unpacking to tensor rank
lessons.summary: Extract the correct number of stride values for each tensor.
lessons.lesson: Do not assume a tensor has three strides; use tensor.stride() and unpack exactly the number of dimensions the kernel expects, or pass strides explicitly from the caller.

lessons.title: Match dtypes for batched GEMM
lessons.summary: Both inputs to torch.bmm (or torch.matmul) must have the same dtype.
lessons.lesson: If you cast one operand (e.g., the weight matrix) to float16 for speed, also cast the other operand to float16 before the batched matmul, or keep both in float32; mixing float32 and float16 raises a runtime error.

lessons.title: Delegate N³ contraction to cuBLAS
lessons.summary: Perform the cubic contraction with a batched matrix multiply rather than a full Triton implementation.
lessons.lesson: Reshape the left and right tensors to (B*H, N, N) and compute out = torch.bmm(left, right.transpose(1,2)); this leverages cuBLAS/Tensor‑cores for the dominant O(N³) work while keeping the program simple and fast.

lessons.title: Delegate cubic contraction to cuBLAS
lessons.summary: Reshape tensors to (B*H, N, N) and use torch.bmm for the N³ work.
lessons.lesson: When implementing the outgoing TriMul, never write a full N³ Triton GEMM; instead reshape left and right tensors to (B*H, N, N) (FP16) and call torch.bmm (or torch.matmul) which leverages cuBLAS/Tensor‑cores. Keep the kernel limited to elementwise work.

lessons.title: Consistent mixed‑precision casting
lessons.summary: Keep arithmetic in FP16, cast to FP32 before LayerNorm and final linear.
lessons.lesson: After the elementwise kernel, keep tensors in FP16 for the batched GEMM; once the GEMM result is obtained, cast it to FP32 before any LayerNorm or final linear projection, and also cast weight tensors to the same dtype to avoid dtype‑mismatch errors.
